name: Legato vocal (music-production build)
comment: A voice singing "ah", from the legato vocal tutorial library, CC0 1.0: sustained notes, each looped (0:52); the library's short notes are left out, as most slide into their pitch. Source: https://github.com/sfzinstruments/legato_vocal_tutorial at fac6461ee4c7f498b23246eced644616fa58d2ec. Changes: pitch-checked against file names (a reading an octave off taken as the named note), intonation offsets up to 70 cents as fineTune, leading silence trimmed, levels matched, 16-bit TPDF dither.
